trust_decision.summary: The server decides whether a client-sent dehydrated props payload is authentic by recomputing HMAC-SHA256 over the key-sorted JSON props and comparing it to @checksum in LiveComponentHydrator::verifyChecksum, but the MAC preimage is only the props data: it omits which component name and which slot (props vs propsFromParent) the blob was minted for, so a blob legitimately signed for one component or slot is accepted for another.

landing_point.why: The advisory names LiveComponentHydrator and an HMAC checksum, so the first place an engineer reads is calculateChecksum(), the single function that builds the checksum preimage.

fix_sites.entry_point: Twig render of a live component (AddLiveAttributesSubscriber::getLiveAttributes -> LiveControllerAttributesCreator::attributesForRendering) and Twig getComponentUrl() (LiveComponentRuntime::getComponentUrl) both call dehydrate()

fix_sites.module_kind: public low-level API (MAC producer without component context)

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP live-component endpoint ux_live_component ('/{_live_component}/{_live_action}') -> LiveComponentSubscriber::hydrateComponent() -> hydrate() (and batch via BatchActionController)
HTTP live-component endpoint, propsFromParent envelope merged into the original props by combineAndValidateProps()
fix_sites.module_kind: core hydrator / merge route (second MAC verification)

fix_sites.entry_point: child component re-render during a parent render (InterceptChildComponentRenderSubscriber::preComponentCreated -> ChildComponentPartialRenderer::renderChildComponent)
fix_sites.module_kind: render wrapper/composition, separate subsystem in the same package

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The child-partial renderer re-signs only props already filtered by getOnlyPropsThatAcceptUpdatesFromParent() and re-derived server-side on every render, so a solver can argue that second signing site is not attacker-controlled and needs no slot/name binding.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Client-sent `updated` values for #[LiveProp(writable: true)] props are deliberately not covered by the HMAC (only the original props envelope is) and must still be applied on every live action; a fix that folds `updated` into the checksum, or requires a checksum for it, breaks legitimate live updates, form binding and batch actions.

O6_input_shapes: props array in the `props` slot (dehydrate -> data-live-props-value / getComponentUrl -> hydrate)
props array in the `propsFromParent` slot (ChildComponentPartialRenderer -> data-live-props-updated-from-parent-value -> hydrate)
component identity variant: identical props replayed under a different component name (componentA vs componentB)
empty props array and empty propsFromParent (count 0 skips the second verification)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second props MAC (the child re-render fingerprint) built with the same secret but no component name in the preimage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same 'HMAC a filtered props array for the client' idiom introduced for the child-component feature, so a maintainer hardening checksum binding would plausibly harden it in the same pass.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The identical base64(HMAC-SHA256(json_encode(data))) @checksum construction in another package, with no entity/field context in the preimage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Character-for-character the same construction and the same @checksum key, so a maintainer applying the rule 'a MAC over a client payload must name its context' would copy the fix here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A URL-bound LiveProp path that writes client-controlled values onto the component through hydrateValue() with no MAC at all
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a genuine second entrance into the same hydrateValue() machinery; a maintainer adding integrity coverage for props could extend the slot-bound checksum to this extractor.

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of data authenticity (HMAC not bound to component/slot context)

O10_build.toolchain: Composer (PHP >= 8.1) + PHPUnit through symfony/phpunit-bridge; per-package phpunit.xml.dist
services: sqlite via DATABASE_URL for the LiveComponent test kernel (src/LiveComponent/phpunit.xml.dist:16); no external service

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the component name only where it is easy (dehydrate/verifyChecksum) or accept both old and new checksum formats for BC, leaving addChecksumToData() and the propsFromParent producer in ChildComponentPartialRenderer unbound.
